General knowledge of other areas of IT. Thorough understanding of and experience with systems-related issues and actions that can be taken to improve or correct performance.
Demonstrated experience writing and editing complex scripts in Microsoft PowerShell used to perform system maintenance and administration.
Advanced knowledge of computer security best practices and policies including demonstrated experience securing server-based software.
Demonstrated experience administering servers in Amazon Web Services or Microsoft Azure.
3-5 yearsof experience in one or more of the following fields: Microsoft Windows server administration, virtualization technologies, information technology.

Under the general supervision of the Manager, Windows Services Group, the Windows System Administrator applies skills as a seasoned, experienced systems infrastructure professional with a full understanding of industry best practices and campus, medical center or Office of the President policies and procedures to resolve a wide range of issues that are moderately complex in scope involving various Microsoft technologies, security vulnerability remediation, network design, and integration. Selects methods and techniques to obtain solutions. Evaluates new technologies including performing simple to moderate cost / benefit analyses.
Adhere to OIT’s cultural values: Collaboration, Respect, Trust, Transparency, Quality, Inclusiveness, Customer Centricity, and Learning and Growth.
Must pass a UC Irvine Police Department Live Scan.
After hours work may be required.
Ability to elicit and communicate technical and non-technical information in a clear and concise manner.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Demonstrates problem-solving skills. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines.
Basic knowledge of how to apply technologies and systems to meet business needs.
Ability to write technical documentation in a clear and concise manner.
Understanding of system performance monitoring and actions that can be taken to improve or correct performance.
Knowledge of the design, development and application of technology and systems to meet business needs.

Demonstrated skills associated with adapting equipment and technology to serve user needs. Demonstrated comprehensive understanding of how system management actions affect other systems, system users and dependent / related functions.
